asset.name: ReasoningStatus
asset.description: The restrained activity indicator communicating that the agent is planning, searching, executing, or waiting, without fabricating a narrative of private reasoning.

requires.reason: Certainty and urgency are expressed on the shared orthogonal axes rather than as one flat variant set.
Indeterminate activity uses the shared indicator.
Announcements go through the one shared live region so nothing talks over anything else.

rationale: Deliberately reports observable activity only. Presenting invented inner monologue as the agent's reasoning is a truthfulness problem, not a presentation choice, and this component exists to make the honest version the easy one.
